tree: Summit Ridge Landscaping in Fort Worth, TX wants to thank larger customers. Office manager Brenda Kolb set up one rule.

tree.style: margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 14px; font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: #0b1620;

tree: — Invoice INV-3381 for $1,240.00 is paid by the Halverson family.
— The amount passes the $500.00 filter; a “Send thank-you card” task is created for account manager Cody Reed.
— The payment app sends the same event again; the duplicate is skipped.
— A paid invoice without a mailing address fails with “Missing: mailing address.” Brenda fixes the record and reruns it.
